src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2024 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2024 legislative session year.
rec: 2021 legislative plan (25 Senate districts), used again
Hawaii Office of Elections, Notice of the final legislative and final congressional reapportionment plans adopted by the 2021 Reapportionment Commission, both filed Jan 28, 2022

Same plan as 2022. Census says no state but those listed on its 2024 pages changed from the 2022 cycle; this state is not among them, so the cb_2024 file holds the same plan as cb_2022. The cached cb_2024 file holds 25 districts.
